notes: The guard service now runs RapTech.exe itself (RapTech.exe --service) instead of a copy named systemRunTime.exe, so the guard and the menu share one program and use less memory, and nothing copies the program at every start. The guard puts its own service settings back if anyone changes them and refuses a stop; uninstalling is the only way to turn it off. A PC still set up with the old copy is switched over the next time it arms (one UAC prompt), and the old systemRunTime.exe is deleted once nothing uses it. Goes with counter 1.49.0.
